critique.evidence: Strong dark command-center aesthetic, disciplined cyan/red/yellow semantics, and a clear hero-to-ledger-to-recommendation hierarchy across all viewports. The ROI dial and bordered panels feel cohesive and polished. However, desktop headline wrapping is awkward and nearly collides between lines; mobile ledger values are cramped, with long labels and currency figures competing for width; secondary copy and mono labels are very small and low-contrast; and the tablet/mobile header presents a clipped horizontal navigation strip that feels visually unfinished. Mobile’s stacked recommendation fields also become dense and repetitive.
critique.fix: Refine responsive headline sizing and line-height, increase secondary-text contrast and minimum label size, and redesign the mobile ledger as stacked label/value rows so numbers have breathing room. Give tablet/mobile navigation a more deliberate compact state with a clear active section, and add spacing between the recommendation subgroups.
